mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production and housing starts (both rising above their 3-month moving averages) indicates a broad-based economic recovery, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS above its 3-month moving average) signals monetary tightening that increases real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS rises above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500,000 units signals weak consumer demand for housing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 500,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 11500 (annualized) signals a deepening recession, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 falls below 11500.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) (both rising above their 3-month moving averages) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 3-month moving averages.
